sounds.name: Harsh Bass
sounds.ref: In the style of dark techno basslines
sounds.blurb: A low, snarling sawtooth bass with a bite at the front of every note.
sounds.how: Generator I an octave down into a fairly closed filter with some resonance: the Polivoks filter turns gritty even at middle settings. A short filter envelope opens it on each note and the amplifier stays up while the key is held.

steps.title: Down an octave
steps.why:
A bass starts with a low, bright waveform.
- Generator I range (ДИАПАЗОН) 16′: one octave below the default.
- Generator I waveform (ФОРМА) sawtooth: every harmonic, for the filter to carve.
- Generator I level (ГЕНЕРАТОР I) 5: Generator I well up into the filter.
- Listen for: a deep, buzzing note.

steps.title: A gritty filter
steps.why:
Close the filter and give it some edge.
- Cutoff (ЧАСТОТА СРЕЗА) 2: dark, only the low harmonics through.
- Resonance (РЕЗОНАНС) 3: halfway: the cutoff starts to rasp.
- Filter envelope depth (ОГИБАЮЩАЯ) 4: the envelope opens it a long way on each note.
- Filter decay (ЗАТУХАНИЕ) 2: and lets it close again quickly.
- Listen for: a snarl at the start of each note, falling to a dark growl.

steps.title: Short notes
steps.why:
Let the notes stop as the keys come up.
- Amplifier after-sound (ПОСЛЕЗВУЧ.) 0: no tail between the sixteenths.
- Listen for: tight, separate notes.

context.vcf.resonance: How hard the filter rasps at the cutoff.
context.vcf.env: How far each note opens the filter.

tweaks.hear: The filter screams on every note.

sounds.name: Screaming Lead
sounds.ref: In the style of 1980s Soviet rock synth solos
sounds.blurb: A sawtooth lead with the resonance high enough to scream, gliding between notes with a slow vibrato.
sounds.how: High resonance is the Polivoks’s signature: the filter rings and turns harsh as the notes push into it. Glissando slides Generator I from note to note, and a touch of the modulator on its pitch adds vibrato.

steps.title: A sawtooth lead
steps.why:
Start from Generator I’s sawtooth at 8′.
- Generator I waveform (ФОРМА) sawtooth: bright enough to cut through.
- Generator I level (ГЕНЕРАТОР I) 5: well up into the filter.
- Listen for: a plain, buzzy lead.

steps.title: Make it scream
steps.why:
Resonance is where the Polivoks earns its name.
- Cutoff (ЧАСТОТА СРЕЗА) 3: half closed, so the resonance has something to sing on.
- Resonance (РЕЗОНАНС) 5: near the top: harsh, whistling and gritty.
- Filter envelope depth (ОГИБАЮЩАЯ) 2: a little lift at the start of each note.
- Filter decay (ЗАТУХАНИЕ) 3: settling over half a second or so.
- Listen for: a sharp, screaming edge on every note.

steps.title: Glide and vibrato
steps.why:
A lead that slides and sings.
- Glissando (ГЛИССАНДО) 2: Generator I slides between notes.
- Modulator rate (ЧАСТОТА) 4: a vibrato speed.
- Generator I modulation (МОДУЛЯЦИЯ) 1: just a little pitch wobble.
- Listen for: each note sliding into the next, with a slight shimmer.

context.gen1.glide: How long Generator I takes to reach each new note.

tweaks.hear: A plain, polite lead: the scream is all resonance.

sounds.name: Two Voices
sounds.ref: In the style of duophonic synth leads over a held bass note
sounds.blurb: A melody on top of a held bass note, both from one Polivoks: the top line glides, the bass stays put.
sounds.how: In 2-ГОЛ. Generator I plays the highest key held and Generator II the lowest. Hold a bass note and play a tune above it, and the two run as separate voices through the one filter. Glissando moves only Generator I, so the melody slides while the bass never does.

steps.title: Two keys, two generators
steps.why:
Switch the keyboard to two voices.
- Voices (1-ГОЛ. / 2-ГОЛ.) 2-ГОЛ. (two voices): the top key on Generator I, the bottom key on Generator II.
- Generator II waveform (ФОРМА) sawtooth: Generator II the same waveform, for the bass.
- Generator II level (ГЕНЕРАТОР II) 4: and bring it into the mixer.
- Listen for: the held bass note sounding under the melody.

steps.title: A warm filter
steps.why:
Round off both voices together.
- Cutoff (ЧАСТОТА СРЕЗА) 4: a little closed.
- Resonance (РЕЗОНАНС) 2: a slight edge.
- Filter envelope depth (ОГИБАЮЩАЯ) 1: a small lift on each new key.
- Filter decay (ЗАТУХАНИЕ) 3: settling quickly.
- Listen for: a softer, warmer blend.

steps.title: Only the top slides
steps.why:
Glissando belongs to Generator I alone.
- Glissando (ГЛИССАНДО) 2: the melody slides; the bass never moves.
- Listen for: the tune gliding over a bass that jumps cleanly when it changes.

context.kbd.voices: One voice, or two keys on two generators.

tweaks.hear: Both generators follow the last key: the bass disappears.

sounds.name: FM Bell
sounds.ref: In the style of Soviet science-fiction film scores
sounds.blurb: A clangorous, metallic bell that rings out and fades.
sounds.how: Generator II, unheard, frequency-modulates Generator I at audio rate: the sidebands it makes are not in tune with the note, so the tone turns metallic. A fast attack and a long decay with no pedestal shape it like a struck bell.

steps.title: A pure carrier
steps.why:
Start from a soft waveform for the modulation to colour.
- Generator I waveform (ФОРМА) triangle: nearly a sine: the FM adds all the harmonics.
- Generator II waveform (ФОРМА) triangle: the modulator, Generator II.
- Generator II range (ДИАПАЗОН) 4′: an octave above: an audio-rate modulator.
- Generator II detune (РАССТРОЙКА) 1: off a simple ratio, for an inharmonic, bell-like tone.
- Listen for: still a soft tone: Generator II is not in the mixer.

steps.title: Frequency modulation
steps.why:
Let Generator II move Generator I’s pitch at audio rate.
- Generator II to Generator I (ГЕНЕРАТОР II) 4: strong FM: metallic sidebands.
- Listen for: the tone turning clangorous.

steps.title: Strike and ring
steps.why:
Shape it like a struck bell.
- Amplifier pedestal (ПЬЕДЕСТАЛ) 0: no sustain: every note dies away.
- Amplifier decay (ЗАТУХАНИЕ) 4: a long ring.
- Amplifier after-sound (ПОСЛЕЗВУЧ.) 3: still ringing after the key comes up.
- Cutoff (ЧАСТОТА СРЕЗА) 5: open, so the sidebands get through.
- Filter envelope depth (ОГИБАЮЩАЯ) 0: no filter movement.
- Filter decay (ЗАТУХАНИЕ) 0: the filter envelope is not used.
- Listen for: bell strokes that ring and fade.

context.gen1.fm: How strongly Generator II modulates Generator I.
context.gen2.detune: The ratio between the two: what kind of bell.

tweaks.hear: A tuned ratio: hollow and organ-like rather than bell-like.

sounds.name: FM Growl
sounds.ref: In the style of industrial basslines
sounds.blurb: A rough, growling bass: Generator II wobbles Generator I just below audio rate.
sounds.how: With Generator II two octaves below Generator I, its frequency modulation is a fast, rough warble rather than a clean bell tone. The filter is half closed with resonance, so the growl is gritty.

steps.title: Generator II far below
steps.why:
Set the modulator well below the note.
- Generator I range (ДИАПАЗОН) 16′: a bass register.
- Generator II range (ДИАПАЗОН) 32′: an octave further down.
- Generator II waveform (ФОРМА) square: a hard-edged modulator.
- Listen for: no change yet: Generator II is not heard.

steps.title: Growl
steps.why:
Modulate Generator I from Generator II.
- Generator II to Generator I (ГЕНЕРАТОР II) 3: a rough, buzzing wobble.
- Listen for: the bass turning growly and unstable.

steps.title: Grit
steps.why:
Close the filter on the growl.
- Cutoff (ЧАСТОТА СРЕЗА) 3: take off the fizz.
- Resonance (РЕЗОНАНС) 3: a gritty edge.
- Filter envelope depth (ОГИБАЮЩАЯ) 2: a little push on each note.
- Filter decay (ЗАТУХАНИЕ) 2: falling quickly.
- Listen for: a thick, snarling bass.

context.gen1.fm: How hard Generator II shakes Generator I’s pitch.

tweaks.hear: The growl speeds up and turns more metallic.

sounds.name: Band-pass Vox
sounds.ref: In the style of 1980s synth-pop talking leads
sounds.blurb: A thin, vocal lead whose band of tone drifts slowly up and down.
sounds.how: The band-pass keeps only a band of harmonics round the cutoff, so the sound is thin and nasal. Resonance narrows it, and the modulator sweeps the band slowly, like a voice saying “wah”.

steps.title: A band, not a slope
steps.why:
Switch the filter to band-pass.
- Filter mode (ПФ / ФНЧ) ПФ (band-pass): only a band of harmonics round the cutoff.
- Cutoff (ЧАСТОТА СРЕЗА) 3: the band low in the mid-range.
- Resonance (РЕЗОНАНС) 4: a narrow, vocal band.
- Filter envelope depth (ОГИБАЮЩАЯ) 0: no envelope on the filter.
- Filter decay (ЗАТУХАНИЕ) 0: the filter envelope is not used.
- Listen for: a thin, nasal tone.

steps.title: A slow sweep
steps.why:
Let the modulator move the band.
- Modulator shape (РЕЖИМ) triangle: a smooth up and down.
- Modulator rate (ЧАСТОТА) 2: slow.
- Filter modulation (МОДУЛЯЦИЯ) 3: a wide sweep.
- Listen for: the tone talking slowly, “ow-wah”.

context.vcf.mode: Band-pass keeps a band; low-pass keeps everything below.

tweaks.hear: Fuller and rounder: a wah rather than a voice.

sounds.name: Repeating Pulse
sounds.ref: In the style of Berlin-school synth pulses
sounds.blurb: A held chord of notes that pulses on its own, with no sequencer: the envelopes repeat.
sounds.how: In repeat (накат) mode an envelope rises and falls over and over while the key is held. With both envelopes repeating, one key becomes a steady stream of plucks, its speed set by the attack and decay.

steps.title: Plucked notes
steps.why:
First make each note a short pluck.
- Amplifier pedestal (ПЬЕДЕСТАЛ) 0: no sustain.
- Amplifier decay (ЗАТУХАНИЕ) 1: a short fall.
- Cutoff (ЧАСТОТА СРЕЗА) 2: fairly dark.
- Filter envelope depth (ОГИБАЮЩАЯ) 4: the envelope opens the filter on each pluck.
- Filter decay (ЗАТУХАНИЕ) 1: and closes it fast.
- Resonance (РЕЗОНАНС) 3: a squelch on each one.
- Listen for: one short pluck per key.

steps.title: Repeat while held
steps.why:
Switch both envelopes to repeat.
- Amplifier envelope mode repeat (накат): the loudness rises and falls again and again.
- Filter envelope mode repeat (накат): and so does the filter.
- Listen for: the held note turning into a steady pulse.

context.aenv.mode: Single: once a key. Repeat: over and over while it is held.

sounds.name: Computer Burble
sounds.ref: In the style of 1970s and 80s science-fiction computers
sounds.blurb: A held note whose tone jumps to a new random setting several times a second: the film computer thinking.
sounds.how: The modulator’s stepped shape holds a new random value on each beat of its rate. Sent to the cutoff of a resonant filter, it picks a new brightness each step, the burble of every film computer.

steps.title: A resonant filter
steps.why:
Give the random steps something to play.
- Cutoff (ЧАСТОТА СРЕЗА) 3: in the middle.
- Resonance (РЕЗОНАНС) 5: high, so each step rings.
- Filter envelope depth (ОГИБАЮЩАЯ) 0: no envelope.
- Filter decay (ЗАТУХАНИЕ) 0: the filter envelope is not used.
- Listen for: a ringing, resonant tone.

steps.title: Random steps
steps.why:
The stepped modulator on the cutoff.
- Modulator shape (РЕЖИМ) stepped: a new random value each beat.
- Modulator rate (ЧАСТОТА) 4: several a second.
- Filter modulation (МОДУЛЯЦИЯ) 4: wide jumps of tone.
- Listen for: the tone hopping about at random.

context.lfo.shape: Stepped is sample and hold: random, held steps.

sounds.name: Siren
sounds.ref: In the style of 1980s Soviet electronic sound effects
sounds.blurb: A wailing siren: the modulator sweeps Generator I’s pitch up and down.
sounds.how: The modulator’s triangle on Generator I’s pitch, slow and deep, glides the note up and down several semitones.

steps.title: A bright tone
steps.why:
A siren needs a cutting waveform.
- Generator I waveform (ФОРМА) square: hollow and piercing.
- Cutoff (ЧАСТОТА СРЕЗА) 5: open.
- Filter envelope depth (ОГИБАЮЩАЯ) 0: no filter movement.
- Filter decay (ЗАТУХАНИЕ) 0: the filter envelope is not used.
- Listen for: a steady, hollow note.

steps.title: Wail
steps.why:
Sweep the pitch.
- Modulator shape (РЕЖИМ) triangle: smoothly up and down.
- Modulator rate (ЧАСТОТА) 2: about a sweep a second.
- Generator I modulation (МОДУЛЯЦИЯ) 4: deep: several semitones.
- Listen for: the note wailing up and down.

context.gen1.mod: How far the modulator moves Generator I’s pitch.

sounds.name: Wind and Surf
sounds.ref: In the style of Soviet radio-play sound effects
sounds.blurb: Wind or surf: noise through a slowly moving filter, swelling in and dying away.
sounds.how: The manual names wind and surf as jobs for the noise. Through a resonant low-pass whose cutoff the modulator moves slowly, the noise gusts and whistles.

steps.title: Noise only
steps.why:
Swap the generators for noise.
- Generator I level (ГЕНЕРАТОР I) 0: Generator I out.
- Noise level (ШУМ) 5: white noise in.
- Listen for: a hiss.

steps.title: Gusts
steps.why:
A resonant filter, moved slowly by the modulator.
- Cutoff (ЧАСТОТА СРЕЗА) 3: a darker rush.
- Resonance (РЕЗОНАНС) 3: a slight whistle.
- Filter envelope depth (ОГИБАЮЩАЯ) 0: no envelope.
- Filter decay (ЗАТУХАНИЕ) 0: the filter envelope is not used.
- Modulator rate (ЧАСТОТА) 1: very slow.
- Filter modulation (МОДУЛЯЦИЯ) 3: the wind rising and falling.
- Listen for: gusts of wind.

steps.title: Swell and fade
steps.why:
Slow in and out.
- Amplifier attack (АТАКА) 4: a slow swell.
- Amplifier after-sound (ПОСЛЕЗВУЧ.) 4: dying away after the key.
- Listen for: the wind rising as the key goes down, and fading after.

sounds.name: Self-oscillating Whistle
sounds.ref: In the style of experimental electronic music
sounds.blurb: The filter alone, resonance at the top: it rings by itself as a pure whistle.
sounds.how: At full resonance the filter oscillates on its own. Take the generators out and only a whistle at the cutoff is left; a little noise kicks it, and the modulator wavers it.

steps.title: Generators out
steps.why:
Leave only a breath of noise.
- Generator I level (ГЕНЕРАТОР I) 0: Generator I out.
- Noise level (ШУМ) 1: a whisper of noise to start the ring.
- Listen for: almost nothing.

steps.title: Ring
steps.why:
Turn the resonance all the way.
- Resonance (РЕЗОНАНС) 6: the filter oscillates by itself.
- Cutoff (ЧАСТОТА СРЕЗА) 4: the pitch of the whistle.
- Filter envelope depth (ОГИБАЮЩАЯ) 0: no envelope.
- Filter decay (ЗАТУХАНИЕ) 0: the filter envelope is not used.
- Listen for: a harsh, pure whistle.

steps.title: Waver
steps.why:
A little movement.
- Modulator rate (ЧАСТОТА) 3: a moderate wobble.
- Filter modulation (МОДУЛЯЦИЯ) 1: a slight waver in the whistle’s pitch.
- Listen for: the whistle wavering, like a theremin.

context.vcf.resonance: At the top the filter makes its own tone.

sounds.name: Square Trill
sounds.ref: In the style of 1980s video-game music
sounds.blurb: A note that flips quickly between two pitches: a trill from the modulator’s square.
sounds.how: The modulator’s square jumps between two values. On Generator I’s pitch it makes a trill; its depth sets the interval.

steps.title: A thin pulse
steps.why:
A narrow, game-like tone.
- Generator I waveform (ФОРМА) pulse 1: thin and nasal.
- Cutoff (ЧАСТОТА СРЕЗА) 5: open.
- Filter envelope depth (ОГИБАЮЩАЯ) 0: no filter movement.
- Filter decay (ЗАТУХАНИЕ) 0: the filter envelope is not used.
- Listen for: a reedy note.

steps.title: Trill
steps.why:
The square on the pitch.
- Modulator shape (РЕЖИМ) square: two values, nothing between.
- Modulator rate (ЧАСТОТА) 4: fast.
- Generator I modulation (МОДУЛЯЦИЯ) 2: a couple of semitones.
- Listen for: each note trilling.

sounds.name: Tremolo Organ
sounds.ref: In the style of Soviet estrada organ sounds
sounds.blurb: A hollow organ tone with a throbbing tremolo.
sounds.how: Generators I and II together at different ranges give an organ-like stack of octaves; the modulator on the amplifier pulses the loudness.

steps.title: Two footages
steps.why:
Stack two octaves like organ stops.
- Generator I waveform (ФОРМА) square: hollow.
- Generator II waveform (ФОРМА) square: the same.
- Generator II range (ДИАПАЗОН) 4′: an octave above.
- Generator II level (ГЕНЕРАТОР II) 3: a little quieter than Generator I.
- Cutoff (ЧАСТОТА СРЕЗА) 4: slightly dulled.
- Filter envelope depth (ОГИБАЮЩАЯ) 0: no filter movement.
- Filter decay (ЗАТУХАНИЕ) 0: the filter envelope is not used.
- Listen for: a full, hollow organ tone.

steps.title: Tremolo
steps.why:
Pulse the loudness.
- Modulator rate (ЧАСТОТА) 4: a quick throb.
- Amplifier modulation (МОДУЛЯЦИЯ) 3: a clear tremolo.
- Listen for: the organ throbbing.

context.vca.mod: How much the modulator moves the loudness.

sounds.name: Detuned Brass
sounds.ref: In the style of 1980s synth-pop brass stabs
sounds.blurb: A fat, brassy tone: two detuned sawtooths with a slow filter swell at the front.
sounds.how: Generator II slightly detuned against Generator I makes the two beat and sound thick. A filter envelope with some attack opens the tone like a brass player starting a note.

steps.title: Two saws, beating
steps.why:
Thicken the tone.
- Generator II waveform (ФОРМА) sawtooth: a second sawtooth.
- Generator II level (ГЕНЕРАТОР II) 4: as loud as Generator I.
- Generator II detune (РАССТРОЙКА) 0.3: just off, so they beat.
- Listen for: a thick, chorused tone.

steps.title: Brass swell
steps.why:
Open the filter slowly at the start of each note.
- Cutoff (ЧАСТОТА СРЕЗА) 2: dark at rest.
- Filter envelope depth (ОГИБАЮЩАЯ) 4: opened a long way by the envelope.
- Filter attack (АТАКА) 2: a short swell.
- Filter decay (ЗАТУХАНИЕ) 3: settling back.
- Filter pedestal (ПЬЕДЕСТАЛ) 3: staying half open while held.
- Listen for: each note blooming like brass.

context.gen2.detune: How far Generator II is from Generator I.

sounds.name: Noise Snare
sounds.ref: In the style of 1980s electro drum sounds
sounds.blurb: A snappy snare made from a burst of noise.
sounds.how: Noise through a resonant filter, with the loudness envelope falling fast and no pedestal, is a snare drum.

steps.title: Noise only
steps.why:
A snare is noise.
- Generator I level (ГЕНЕРАТОР I) 0: Generator I out.
- Noise level (ШУМ) 6: noise all the way up.
- Listen for: a hiss.

steps.title: Snap
steps.why:
A short burst.
- Amplifier pedestal (ПЬЕДЕСТАЛ) 0: no sustain.
- Amplifier decay (ЗАТУХАНИЕ) 2: a quick fall, about a tenth of a second.
- Amplifier after-sound (ПОСЛЕЗВУЧ.) 0: no tail.
- Cutoff (ЧАСТОТА СРЕЗА) 4: bright but not fizzy.
- Resonance (РЕЗОНАНС) 2: a little body.
- Filter envelope depth (ОГИБАЮЩАЯ) 0: no filter movement.
- Filter decay (ЗАТУХАНИЕ) 0: the filter envelope is not used.
- Listen for: snare hits.

sounds.name: Squelch Line
sounds.ref: In the style of acid house
sounds.blurb: A squelchy, resonant line that slides from note to note.
sounds.how: A square through a resonant filter with a short, deep envelope squelches on every note. A short glissando on Generator I slides each note into the next.

steps.title: A square bass
steps.why:
The square gives a hollow, woody squelch.
- Generator I waveform (ФОРМА) square: hollow.
- Generator I range (ДИАПАЗОН) 16′: down an octave.
- Generator I level (ГЕНЕРАТОР I) 5: well up.
- Listen for: a hollow bass.

steps.title: Squelch
steps.why:
Resonance and a short, deep envelope.
- Cutoff (ЧАСТОТА СРЕЗА) 1: closed.
- Resonance (РЕЗОНАНС) 5: high: the squelch.
- Filter envelope depth (ОГИБАЮЩАЯ) 5: opened a long way.
- Filter decay (ЗАТУХАНИЕ) 1: and snapped shut.
- Listen for: every note squelching.

steps.title: Slides
steps.why:
A short glissando.
- Glissando (ГЛИССАНДО) 1: each note slides briefly into the next.
- Amplifier after-sound (ПОСЛЕЗВУЧ.) 0: clean stops.
- Listen for: the line sliding up and down between notes.
